description: Given a domain, list the technologies detected on it (analytics, hosting, ecommerce platform, frameworks and so on), each with its category and how many sites overall use it. Use this to answer 'what is this site built with?'. Costs 1 credit.

domain.description: Bare domain, e.g. example.com (no scheme, no path)

limit.description: Max technologies to return (default 50, cap 100). 50 is the full stack for over 99.9% of domains.

name: lookup_domain_technologies
title: List a domain's technology stack
